One source, three views

The line item is the record. Bill → ① Line Items sets its order (▲▼) and its kind (Order / Any / —). Edit → Stages reads it back with the eye and the customer preview. The portal shows only the rows with the eye on.

Draws follow stages

A numbered stage bills when it passes; a ◆ stage bills when it's done; a plain line item rides on the final draw. "Ready to bill" becomes a fact of the stage, not something the office has to notice.

Change orders arrive as ◆

Applying a change order adds its line item as an any-time stage, tagged with the CO number and hidden from the customer until the eye is on. Its draw appears the day it's done.

Nothing else moves

Payments received, the cost timeline, labor and charges are untouched. The Job and History tabs are untouched. The Subs → Work board keeps the window and pick controls.
